data_fields.name: entry_weight
data_fields.donor_constant: SpawnedProbability, roll 1..sum of enabled open entries

data_fields.name: trigger_range
data_fields.donor_constant: TriggerRange set from constructor argument (default not read)

data_fields.name: home_return_margin
data_fields.donor_constant: RangeHome + 5 tiles before a creature counts as displaced

best_idea: A zone population rule with a zone-wide cap, a per-type cap, one spawn per random respawn timer fire, a presence trigger that spawns one when a player enters an empty zone, and a 15 to 59 second grace before a displaced creature goes home.
decision_why: Take the caps, the one-per-fire timer with a random min-max delay, the restart-on-death rule and the presence trigger as zone data for row 23. Do not take the grace as a despawn: the donor sends the creature home and does not delete it, so despawn-on-empty needs its own decision.
acceptance: Server test: zone cap 3 never holds more than 3 live spawns; one spawn per respawn fire; a death restarts a stopped timer; a player entering an empty zone whose timer is due gets exactly one spawn now; a creature displaced by an empty sector returns home 15 to 59 s later.
